pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zhǐ shàng de " liǎngbèi " quānqǐlái , yòu huàdiào quān .
pairs.english: Tavi circled “twice” on the paper, then crossed out the circle.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把纸上的“两倍”圈起来，又划掉圈。

pairs.target: tànbǐ yǐjīng hěn duǎn , cèmiàn yí pèng zhǐ , biàn liúxià yíkuài hēi .
pairs.english: The charcoal pencil was already very short; whenever its side touched the paper it left a black smear.
pairs.hanzi: 炭笔已经很短，侧面一碰纸，便留下一块黑。

pairs.target: cóng jièlái nà běn suànshù cè qǐ , tā měitiān wǎnfàn hòu dōu zuò jǐdào tí .
pairs.english: Ever since borrowing that arithmetic book, he had done a few problems after supper each day.
pairs.hanzi: 从借来那本算术册起，他每天晚饭后都做几道题。

pairs.target: zuòdào jīntiān , réng huì bǎ gāi chú de dìfāng chéngguòqù ,
pairs.english: Even now he sometimes multiplied where he should divide,
pairs.hanzi: 做到今天，仍会把该除的地方乘过去，

pairs.target: dàn zhìshǎo néng zài dáàn dà dé lípǔ shí tíngxiàlái , ér búshì hěn rènzhēn dì bǎ cuòwù miáo dé gèng hēi .
pairs.english: but at least he could stop when the answer grew absurdly large, rather than conscientiously darkening the error.
pairs.hanzi: 但至少能在答案大得离谱时停下来，而不是很认真地把错误描得更黑。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī zhècì méiyǒu fā yíyàng dà de tiěpiàn .
pairs.english: This time Teacher Vey hadn't handed out equal-sized iron pieces.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师这次没有发一样大的铁片。

pairs.target: zuǒbiān nà jiàn duǎn hòu , yòubiān nà jiàn báo cháng , dōu búguò shǒuzhǎng dàxiǎo .
pairs.english: The left piece was short and thick, the right thin and long; both were no bigger than a palm.
pairs.hanzi: 左边那件短厚，右边那件薄长，都不过手掌大小。

pairs.target: liǎngjiàn zhuāng zài gèzì de mù zuò shàng , xiǎo fǎmǎ xuán zài xiàfāng , hòumiàn lì zhe liǎngtiáo kèdù .
pairs.english: Each sat in its own wooden mount, small weights hanging below, with two scales standing behind.
pairs.hanzi: 两件装在各自的木座上，小砝码悬在下方，后面立着两条刻度。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi mō guò jiēchù chù , guānghuá , què méiyǒu liànxí liú xìng shí nà quān qiǎn cáo .
pairs.english: Tavi felt the contact patches: smooth, but without the ring of shallow grooves used for retention practice.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维摸过接触处，光滑，却没有练习留性时那圈浅槽。

pairs.target: " jīntiān shǒu bù líkāi . " wéi lǎoshī shuō .
pairs.english: “Your hands stay on today,” Teacher Vey said.
pairs.hanzi: “今天手不离开。”维老师说。

pairs.target: tā ràng tā xiān kàn yàngjiàn dēngjì , zài duìzhào zhuōshàng de huànsuànbiǎo .
pairs.english: She had him read the sample register first, then compare it with the conversion table on the desk.
pairs.hanzi: 她让他先看样件登记，再对照桌上的换算表。

pairs.target: duǎn hòu de nà jiàn suǒ hán de tiěliào , qià shì báo cháng nà jiàn de liǎngbèi .
pairs.english: The short, thick piece contained exactly twice as much iron as the thin, long one.
pairs.hanzi: 短厚的那件所含的铁料，恰是薄长那件的两倍。

pairs.target: guà shàng guīdìng de qīngzǎi , liǎnggēn zhǐzhēn gè tíng zài bùtóng de wèizhì .
pairs.english: With the specified light loads attached, the two pointers stopped at different positions.
pairs.hanzi: 挂上规定的轻载，两根指针各停在不同的位置。

pairs.target: tāmen xíngzhuàng bùtóng , běnlái jiù bùnéng ná yǎnqián wānxiàqù duōshǎo , zhíjiē dàngchéng ruǎnyìng biànhuà duōshǎo .
pairs.english: Their shapes differed, so visible deflection couldn't simply be equated with change in compliance.
pairs.hanzi: 它们形状不同，本来就不能拿眼前弯下去多少，直接当成软硬变化多少。

pairs.target: biǎo bǎ zhè liǎngjiàn de xíngzhuàng hé yuányǒu xiǎngyìng zhé dào le tóng yítào bǐjiào shùlǐ .
pairs.english: The table converted both their geometry and original response into one shared set of comparative values.
pairs.hanzi: 表把这两件的形状和原有响应折到了同一套比较数里。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī jiào tā zhǐchū , ruò zuǒbiān shǎo ràng yíbù , yòubiān yìng duō ràng jǐbù .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey asked him to show how many steps more the right should yield if the left yielded one step less.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师叫他指出，若左边少让一步，右边应多让几步。

pairs.target: " liǎngbù . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “Two steps,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi: “两步。”塔维说。

pairs.target: " nǎbiān de liǎngbù ? "
pairs.english: “Two steps on which one?”
pairs.hanzi: “哪边的两步？”

pairs.target: tā chàdiǎn qù zhǐ yòubiān kèdù shàng de liǎnggè xiǎogé ,
pairs.english: He almost pointed to two small divisions on the right-hand scale,
pairs.hanzi: 他差点去指右边刻度上的两个小格，

pairs.target: shǒu shēn dào yíbàn , shōuhuí lái , zhǐ zhù huànsuànbiǎo .
pairs.english: but withdrew his hand halfway and pointed to the conversion table.
pairs.hanzi: 手伸到一半，收回来，指住换算表。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī diǎntóu , bǎ tā de jìlùzhǐ yā zài zhènzhǐ xià .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey nodded and secured his record sheet beneath a paperweight.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师点头，把他的记录纸压在镇纸下。

pairs.target: zhōuwéi bǐ píngrì ānjìng .
pairs.english: It was quieter around him than usual.
pairs.hanzi: 周围比平日安静。

pairs.target: néng shàng zhè zhāng zhuō de rén hái bù duō ,
pairs.english: Not many people had yet qualified for this bench.
pairs.hanzi: 能上这张桌的人还不多，

pairs.target: luò héng zài gébì jiǎnchá mù zuò , dé mǎ zé liúzài lìngyìbiān zuò shúxī de shuāngshǒu líkāi liànxí .
pairs.english: Lohen was inspecting a wooden mount next door, while Dema stayed on the other side to practise the familiar two-hand release.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡在隔壁检查木座，德玛则留在另一边做熟悉的双手离开练习。

pairs.target: tā xiānqián yǐ shuō guò , jīntiān bú huàn tímù :
pairs.english: She had already said she wasn't changing exercises today:
pairs.hanzi: 她先前已说过，今天不换题目：

pairs.target: shàng yìhuí tā sōngkāi zuǒshǒu bǐ yòushǒu zǎo , xiǎng xiān bǎ zhèjiàn shì liàn hǎo .
pairs.english: last time she had lifted her left hand before her right, and she wanted to get that right first.
pairs.hanzi: 上一回她松开左手比右手早，想先把这件事练好。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zuǒzhǎng tiē zài hòu jiàn de luǒ miànshàng , yòushǒu fúzhù báo jiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi placed his left palm on the thick piece's bare patch and held the thin piece with his right hand.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把左掌贴在厚件的裸面上，右手扶住薄件。

pairs.target: mù zuò shàng de dǎng kuài dōu zài , fǎmǎ xiàfāng yě yǒu jiēpán .
pairs.english: The stops on the wooden mounts were in place, with catch trays beneath the weights.
pairs.hanzi: 木座上的挡块都在，砝码下方也有接盘。

pairs.target: tā kàn le yìyǎn , cái bǎ zhùyìlì yí dào zhǐ xià .
pairs.english: He checked them before shifting his attention beneath his fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 他看了一眼，才把注意力移到指下。

pairs.target: kāishǐ shí , liǎngjiàn dōngxī zǒng xiàng bú zài tóng yìzhāng zhuōshàng .
pairs.english: At first the two pieces kept seeming as though they weren't on the same table.
pairs.hanzi: 开始时，两件东西总像不在同一张桌上。

pairs.target: hòu jiàn zài zuǒshǒu xiàmiàn hěn qīngchǔ , báo jiàn què xiàng bèi tā jǐ dào yuǎnchù .
pairs.english: The thick piece was distinct under his left hand, but the thin one seemed squeezed into the distance.
pairs.hanzi: 厚件在左手下面很清楚，薄件却像被他挤到远处。

pairs.target: tā bú zìjué dì zhī qù zhǎo hòu jiàn lǐ yǔ lìng yíjiàn xiāngfǎng de nà yìdiǎn , xiǎng bǎ liǎngbiān còuchéng duìchèn .
pairs.english: Unconsciously he sought only the part of the thick piece that resembled the other, trying to make the sides symmetrical.
pairs.hanzi: 他不自觉地只去找厚件里与另一件相仿的那一点，想把两边凑成对称。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī kàn tā de jiān yuè tái yuè gāo , jiào tā xiān bié shèdìng , fàngkāishǒu .
pairs.english: Seeing his shoulders rise higher and higher, Teacher Vey told him not to set the exchange yet and to let go.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师看他的肩越抬越高，叫他先别设定，放开手。

pairs.target: zhǐzhēn méiyǒu dòng . shénme yě méi jièchūqù .
pairs.english: The pointers hadn't moved. Nothing had been borrowed.
pairs.hanzi: 指针没有动。什么也没借出去。

pairs.target: " nǐ gāngcái zhǐgù le zuǒbiān de yíbùfen . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: “Just then you were only attending to part of the left piece,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “你刚才只顾了左边的一部分。”她说。

pairs.target: " tā tài dà le . "
pairs.english: “It's too big.”
pairs.hanzi: “它太大了。”

pairs.target: " tā jiù zài zhèlǐ . búshì yào nǐ bǎ yòubiān xiǎng dà . "
pairs.english: “It's right here. You're not meant to imagine the right one bigger.”
pairs.hanzi: “它就在这里。不是要你把右边想大。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tuì kāi , shuǎi le shuǎi yīn zīshì jiāngyìng ér fāsuān de jiān .
pairs.english: Tavi stepped back and shook out shoulders aching from his stiff posture.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维退开，甩了甩因姿势僵硬而发酸的肩。

pairs.target: tā de shǒuzhǐ hái línghuó , shì zhe kòu le kòu xiùkǒu ;
pairs.english: His fingers were still nimble; he tried fastening his cuff.
pairs.hanzi: 他的手指还灵活，试着扣了扣袖口；

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī kànjiàn , jiào tā zuò zhe xiē yíhuìer , méiyǒu lìkè ràng tā zài lái .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey noticed and told him to sit and rest a while, instead of immediately trying again.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师看见，叫他坐着歇一会儿，没有立刻让他再来。

pairs.target: tā wàng xiàng dé mǎ nàbiān .
pairs.english: He looked over at Dema.
pairs.hanzi: 他望向德玛那边。

pairs.target: tā yǐ fàngkāi shuāngshǒu , zhǐzhēn duǎnzàn tíng zhe , yòu luò huí yuánwèi .
pairs.english: She had lifted both hands; the pointer paused briefly, then fell back to its original position.
pairs.hanzi: 她已放开双手，指针短暂停着，又落回原位。

pairs.target: tā zhòuqǐ bízi , zài zhǐ shàng jì le yìbǐ , suíhòu ná qǐ shuǐbēi , fāxiàn bēizi kōng le .
pairs.english: She wrinkled her nose, made a note, then picked up her cup and found it empty.
pairs.hanzi: 她皱起鼻子，在纸上记了一笔，随后拿起水杯，发现杯子空了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ná qǐ zhuāng liángchá de shuǐhú , tì tā dǎo mǎn , zìjǐ yě dǎo le bànbēi .
pairs.english: Tavi picked up the kettle of cold tea, filled her cup and poured half a cup for himself too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿起装凉茶的水壶，替她倒满，自己也倒了半杯。

pairs.target: tā hēwán , wèn tā shìbushì lǎo xiǎng bǎ dà de yíkuài qièchéng xiǎo de . tā diǎntóu .
pairs.english: After drinking she asked if he kept wanting to cut the large piece into a small one. He nodded.
pairs.hanzi: 她喝完，问他是不是老想把大的一块切成小的。他点头。

pairs.target: " wǒ yǐqián liǎngzhīshǒu zǒng xiǎng yìqǐ shǐjìn . " tā shuō ,
pairs.english: “I used to keep wanting both hands to push together,” she said.
pairs.hanzi: “我以前两只手总想一起使劲。”她说，

pairs.target: " yuè xiǎng yìqǐ , zuǒshǒu yuè qiǎngxiān . fánsǐ le . "
pairs.english: “The more I thought about together, the earlier my left hand went. Maddening.”
pairs.hanzi: “越想一起，左手越抢先。烦死了。”

pairs.target: tā méi gěi tā bànfǎ , tā fǎnér búbì zhuāngzuò yǐjīng dǒng le .
pairs.english: She offered no solution, which meant he didn't have to pretend he already understood.
pairs.hanzi: 她没给他办法，他反而不必装作已经懂了。

pairs.target: lún dào dìèrcì zhǔnbèi shí , tǎ wéi xiān bǎ hòu jiàn de biānjiè cóngtóudàowěi mō le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: When his second preparation turn came, Tavi first felt the thick piece's boundary from end to end.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到第二次准备时，塔维先把厚件的边界从头到尾摸了一遍。

pairs.target: méiyǒu tōutōu shèdiào nǎ yíduàn .
pairs.english: He didn't secretly leave any section out.
pairs.hanzi: 没有偷偷舍掉哪一段。

pairs.target: báo jiàn yě zài lìngyìzhī shǒu xiàmiàn , cháng ér qīng .
pairs.english: The thin piece was beneath his other hand too, long and light.
pairs.hanzi: 薄件也在另一只手下面，长而轻。

pairs.target: tā ràng tāmen gè zhàn gè de wèizhì , méiyǒu jí zhe bǎ nà diǎn bù qízhěng mǒdiào .
pairs.english: He let each occupy its own place, without hurrying to erase the mismatch.
pairs.hanzi: 他让它们各占各的位置，没有急着把那点不齐整抹掉。

pairs.target: tā búzài zhuī zhe liǎngbiān tóngyàng de gǎnjué zǒu , zhī biànrèn gèzì yuánlái zěnyàng ,
pairs.english: He no longer chased an identical feeling on both sides; he recognized each original state,
pairs.hanzi: 他不再追着两边同样的感觉走，只辨认各自原来怎样，

pairs.target: zài bǎ biǎo shàng nà duì hěnxiǎo de biànhuà fàngzàixīnlǐ .
pairs.english: then held the pair of tiny changes from the table in mind.
pairs.hanzi: 再把表上那对很小的变化放在心里。

pairs.target: zuǒbiān yífèn , yòubiān xiāngfǎn de liǎngfèn ;
pairs.english: One unit on the left, two opposite units on the right:
pairs.hanzi: 左边一份，右边相反的两份；

pairs.target: búshì liǎngzhīshǒu tóngyàng yònglì , yě búshì ràng liǎnggēn zhǐzhēn zǒu dé yíyàng yuǎn .
pairs.english: neither equal force from both hands nor equal travel of the pointers.
pairs.hanzi: 不是两只手同样用力，也不是让两根指针走得一样远。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī wèn tā hǎo le méiyǒu . tā yòu děng le yì xī , cái shuōhǎo .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey asked if he was ready. He waited another breath before saying yes.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师问他好了没有。他又等了一息，才说好。

pairs.target: nà diǎn liánxì jiànlì qǐlái shí , bǐ tā yùxiǎng de qīng .
pairs.english: When the slight connection formed, it was lighter than he had expected.
pairs.hanzi: 那点联系建立起来时，比他预想的轻。

pairs.target: zuǒbiān de zhǐzhēn wǎnghuí yí , yòubiān wǎng wài nuó , jùlí bìng bú duìchèn .
pairs.english: The left pointer moved back, the right moved out, their distances unequal.
pairs.hanzi: 左边的指针往回移，右边往外挪，距离并不对称。

pairs.target: tā chàyìdiǎn wèile hǎokàn qù bǔqí , suíjí kànjiàn jìlùzhǐ shàng de liǎngbèi , bǎ nàge niàntou ànzhù .
pairs.english: He almost tried to even them up for appearance's sake, then saw “twice” on the record sheet and checked the impulse.
pairs.hanzi: 他差一点为了好看去补齐，随即看见记录纸上的两倍，把那个念头按住。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bàochū liǎngbiān de dúshù . luò zài yùxiān huà chū de zhǎi kuàng lǐ .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey called out both readings. They fell within the narrow boxes marked in advance.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师报出两边的读数。落在预先画出的窄框里。

pairs.target: tā shuāngshǒu réng tiēzhe tiěmiàn , zhào tā de kǒulìng jiěkāi liánxì .
pairs.english: With both hands still touching the iron, he dissolved the link at her instruction.
pairs.hanzi: 他双手仍贴着铁面，照她的口令解开联系。

pairs.target: xièxià qīngzǎi hòu , liǎngjiàn dōu huídào yuánxiān de wèizhì .
pairs.english: After the light loads were removed, both pieces returned to their original positions.
pairs.hanzi: 卸下轻载后，两件都回到原先的位置。

pairs.target: zài guà yícì , dǐshù yě méiyǒu biàn .
pairs.english: Loaded once more, their baseline readings were unchanged too.
pairs.hanzi: 再挂一次，底数也没有变。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wàng zhe nà liǎnggēn zhēn , liǎnshàng mànmàn fúchū yìdiǎn yābúzhù de xiào .
pairs.english: Looking at the two pointers, Tavi slowly broke into a smile he couldn't suppress.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维望着那两根针，脸上慢慢浮出一点压不住的笑。

pairs.target: " xíng le . jīntiān dào zhèlǐ . " wéi lǎoshī bǎ jìlùzhǐ chōuchūlái .
pairs.english: “Enough. That's all for today.” Teacher Vey pulled out the record sheet.
pairs.hanzi: “行了。今天到这里。”维老师把记录纸抽出来。

pairs.target: tā hái xiǎng zài zuò , táitóu shí què fāxiàn yuǎnchù chuānggé yǒu yíshùn zhòng le yǐng .
pairs.english: He still wanted another try, but when he raised his head, the distant window grid briefly doubled.
pairs.hanzi: 他还想再做，抬头时却发现远处窗格有一瞬重了影。

alignment.english: the distant window grid briefly doubled

pairs.target: búshì shǒu má , shì yǎnjīng lèi le .
pairs.english: Not numb hands: tired eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 不是手麻，是眼睛累了。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu zài zhēng , zuò huí dèng shàng , bǎ tànbǐ xiāojiān .
pairs.english: He didn't argue again, but sat back on the stool and sharpened his charcoal pencil.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有再争，坐回凳上，把炭笔削尖。

pairs.target: dé mǎ shōu hǎo zìjǐ de yàngjiàn , lùguò shí kàn le yìyǎn chéngjì .
pairs.english: Dema packed away her samples and glanced at his result as she passed.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛收好自己的样件，路过时看了一眼成绩。

pairs.target: " xiàcì bié gěi wǒ dǎo nàme mǎn . húdǐ dōu shì zhā . "
pairs.english: “Next time don't fill mine so full. The bottom's all dregs.”
pairs.hanzi: “下次别给我倒那么满。壶底都是渣。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu kàn hú , cái fāxiànzìjǐ nà bànbēi yě hún zhe .
pairs.english: Tavi looked down at the kettle, then realized his own half-cup was murky too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头看壶，才发现自己那半杯也浑着。

pairs.target: tā hē le yìkǒu , kǔ dé lìjí zhòuqǐ liǎn .
pairs.english: He took a sip, so bitter that he immediately screwed up his face.
pairs.hanzi: 他喝了一口，苦得立即皱起脸。

pairs.target: dé mǎ děng de jiùshì zhège , xiào zhe zǒu le .
pairs.english: Dema had been waiting for exactly that; she left laughing.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛等的就是这个，笑着走了。
